coverage: Group reporting segments · depository, database management and banking services
incomeDefinition: Segment revenue includes services recognised by each group business. NSDL reported no revenue between these segments in this table.
definition: Segment results reflect the earnings assigned to each business, before group adjustments including interest income, finance cost and tax. The annual accounts show group profit separately.
sourceLabel: NSDL audited annual report filed with BSE
location: PDF pages 220 and 261–262, consolidated profit and loss and note 28. PDF page 256, note 21, revenue from operations.
notes: The consolidated profit and loss statement reports profit after tax of ₹380.01 crore, of which ₹379.74 crore belonged to owners of the parent. The annual report’s segment note shows a small rounding difference from the profit and loss statement. Reported tax includes ₹7.93 crore relating to earlier years.
insight: Banking Services produced slightly more revenue than Depository. Most segment earnings came from the depository, so the largest revenue line and largest earnings line were different.
